answer_corrections.original_answer: GuardDuty, Security Hub e administracao delegada.
answer_corrections.corrected_answer: AWS Config and Security Hub CSPM with organizational aggregation and delegated administration where supported. GuardDuty complements these controls with threat detection.
answer_corrections.justification: The source equated insecure configuration detection with GuardDuty threat detection. Config evaluates configurations; Security Hub CSPM aggregates posture findings. GuardDuty remains complementary threat detection.

answer_corrections.original_answer: DataSync ou Snow Family conforme volume e conectividade.
answer_corrections.corrected_answer: assess DataSync against an offline transfer option according to data volume, connectivity and availability. Snow Family is historical context; check current eligibility before proposing it.
answer_corrections.justification: The source offered Snow Family without an availability qualification. New customers cannot order Snow devices; choose current online or offline options against bandwidth, volume and eligibility.
